name: 78611 · Burnet, TX
findings: ZIP 78611 (Burnet) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78611 (Burnet) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78611 (Burnet) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.
